FAQ

Questions & Answers

Is the 30-day course free?

Yes. The listed SPAMMING FREE COURSE is free to enroll in.

How do I enroll?

Use the WhatsApp enrollment button and send your request.

Is the live hacking feed real?

No. It is a simulated visual security feed designed for the website interface and training atmosphere.

Can I test someone else's account or website?

No. Security testing should only be performed on systems you own or where you have explicit authorization.
